study_title: Evaluation on SARS-CoV-2 Recombinants from the RIVET Platform

reference.citation: Smith, K., Ye, C., & Turakhia, Y. (2023). Tracking and curating putative SARS-CoV-2 recombinants with RIVET. Bioinformatics, 39(9), btad538.

companion_reference.citation: Turakhia, Y., Thornlow, B., Hinrichs, A. S., De Maio, N., Gozashti, L., Lanfear, R., Haussler, D., & Corbett-Detig, R. (2022). Pandemic-scale phylogenomics reveals the SARS-CoV-2 recombination landscape. Nature, 609(7929), 994-997.

data_provenance.og_data_description: Original empirical public database containing 6,432 inferred recombinant trios, 481 QC PASS trios, and 62 Pango recombinant lineages across the 29,903 nt SARS-CoV-2 genome.
data_provenance.policy: ALWAYS use original alignments when archived; otherwise regenerate strictly following the published procedure.
